a.title: How Berlin's Arab queers are building their community
a.summary: As the co-founder of the ADIRA Drag Festival, Lebanese performance artist, drag performer, DJ and cultural organizer Hassandra has become an essential part of Berlin's queer artistic landscape.

b.title: Wie Berlins arabische Queers ihre Community aufbauen
b.summary: Hassandra gehört zu den bekanntesten Stimmen der queeren arabischen Kunstszene in Berlin. Mit dem 2023 gegründeten ADIRA Drag Festival schafft Hassandra gemeinsam mit anderen, Räume für Austausch und Gemeinschaft.

a.title: Neuer injury gives Urbig chance to shape Bayern and Germany future
a.summary: Manuel Neuer's latest injury gives Jonas Urbig a run of games in Bayern's goal. Marc-André ter Stegen remains Germany’s No. 1, but Urbig now has a chance to strengthen his case for the future.

b.title: Verletzung Manuel Neuer: Schlecht für FC Bayern, gut für Deutschland?
b.summary: Beim FC Bayern München fällt Torhüter Manuel Neuer mit einer Fußverletzung länger aus. Beim deutschen Rekordmeister rückt daher Jonas Urbig ins Tor. Ändert das auch den Kampf um die Nummer eins beim DFB-Team?

a.title: US Republican Thomas Massie launches bid to impeach Pete Hegseth
a.summary: US Republican Thomas Massie moved Monday, November 9, to force a vote to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, pressing his fellow Republicans to remove one of the Trump administration's most prominent figures following sweeping election losses blamed in part on fallout from the war in Iran. FRANCE 24's correspondent in Washington Fraser Jackson has more.

b.title: Frederick Vélez: "Los días de Hegseth en el Pentágono están contados"
b.summary: El congresista republicano Thomas Massie puso en marcha este lunes 9 de noviembre un proceso para destituir al secretario de Defensa, Pete Hegseth. Entre los motivos que esgrime figuran haber iniciado una guerra con Irán sin el aval del Congreso, haber ordenado ataques letales ilegales contra presuntos narcotraficantes y haber capturado a Nicolás Maduro y Cilia Flores sin autorización legal. a.title: Israel's new parliament to be sworn in as Eisenkot prepares government
a.summary: Israel's new parliament is set to be sworn in Tuesday with neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot's camp holding a majority. Eisenkot seeks to build a coalition after receiving a mandate to form a government.

b.title: Israël : Eisenkot pour tourner la page Netanyahu ?
b.summary: Le président israélien Isaac Herzog confie à Gadi Eisenkot le soin de trouver une majorité à la Knesset. Une tentative qui annonce la fin de dix-neuf ans de pouvoir pour Benjamin Netanyahu ?

a.title: France vows tough response to freezer cyberattack blamed on Iran
a.summary: France's Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot said Tuesday, November 10, that Paris ruled out "nothing" to respond to a major cyberattack on hundreds of supermarket fridges in October that it has blamed on Iran. The goal, Jean-Noel Barrot told France Info, is "to deter anyone who might be tempted, in Iran or elsewhere, to do it again".

b.title: Les ministres du G7 réunis à Paris : l'Iran et l'Ukraine au cœur des débats
b.summary: Le chef de la diplomatie française, Jean-Noël Barrot, s'est entretenu mardi 10 novembre à Paris avec son homologue ukrainien, Andrii Sybiha, en marge de ⁠la réunion des ministres des Affaires étrangères du G7.
